paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles with H.E.S.S. from the irregularity of the PKS 2155-304 energy spectrum
notes: H.E.S.S. constraint on ALP-photon coupling from spectral irregularity of PKS 2155-304. The robust/conservative limit is g_gamma-a < 2.1e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP masses 15-60 neV (1.5e-8 to 6e-8 eV), derived assuming a 1 uG galaxy cluster magnetic field over 370 kpc with 10 kpc coherence length. An additional optimistic IGMF-based bound of ~5e-11 GeV^-1 near 1 neV exists but depends on an assumed 1 nG IGMF and is not included in the emitted data. This is an astrophysical bound (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density is assumed.
